placeholders.h_bs_m: typical macro mast height, not tied to a reference
placeholders.h_sensor_m: ground sensor height (given); no clutter or building-penetration loss is modelled

placeholders.haps_spacing_km: HAPS ring radius around the hub HAPS
placeholders.iot_ra_load: IoT preambles per RA resource per opportunity (swept in exp3)
placeholders.n_haps: number of HAPS (one above the hub, the rest on a ring)
placeholders.n_sat: LEO constellation size for the spherical BPP
placeholders.n_sat_cochannel: co-channel users in other satellite beams
placeholders.p_iot_dbm: co-channel IoT uplink interferer maximum power
placeholders.sidelobe_db: sidelobe floor for HAPS and satellite beams
placeholders.tn_core_density_km2: TN urban-core BS density (inter-site distance ~0.5 km)
placeholders.tn_core_radius_km: TN urban-core radius around the hub
placeholders.tn_interferer_radius_m: co-channel uplink user placement around other BSs
placeholders.tn_rural_density_km2: TN rural BS density outside the core (inter-site distance ~4.5 km)
